newsitem.title: USA: Investor suit vs. Nasdaq is class action - paper.
newsitem.headline: Investor suit vs. Nasdaq is class action - paper.

text.p: A lawsuit filed against Nasdaq dealer firms by investors was granted class action status, the Los Angeles Times said.

The class action status increases the chances that Wall Street brokerages may have to pay major damages related to allegations of conspiring to inflate the cost of trading Nasdaq stocks, the newspaper said.
U.S. District Judge Robert Sweet ruled Wednesday that the class can include investors who traded through any of the 33 defendants from May 1, 1989 to May 24, 1994, the newspaper said.
Defendants include such brokerages as Goldman, Sachs & Co; Bear, Stearns; and Merrill Lynch & Co, the newspaper said.
